title: Billing software for dental clinics, product page
opening: we need a landing page for our clinic billing product
persona: Omar Saleh, co-founder of a small software company. Business-minded, answers in clear sentences, wants demo bookings.
facts: The product, Tasdeed, handles insurance billing for small dental clinics in Saudi Arabia.
It is in a pilot with 40 clinics. Pilot clinics report billing work dropping from about 6 hours a week to about 2.
Price: 199 SAR per clinic per month.
The one thing a visitor should do is book a 20-minute demo through a Calendly link he will provide.
Readers are dental clinic owners and practice managers.
Has a logo and product screenshots. Owns tasdeed.sa.
Has no customer quotes yet that he is allowed to publish. Does not want a blog or a chatbot.
taste: If asked for a material or object with the right colour: the mint of dental clinic scrubs and a stamped paper receipt. Wants it to look trustworthy, not flashy. Light ground.

files.product.md:
# Tasdeed

Insurance billing for small dental clinics. Submits claims, tracks rejections, and reminds staff what to resubmit.

Pilot: 40 clinics. Billing time down from about 6 hours a week to about 2.

Price: 199 SAR per clinic per month.
